title: Java Systems Programming coursework with a RAG chatbot
summary: First-year engineering students complete Java coursework and continuous assessments with optional access to a bilingual, course-grounded chatbot. The RAG assistant explains concepts and code and can support assignments and exam preparation, while students remain responsible for checking its responses.

sources.title: Tailoring Your Code Companion: Leveraging LLMs and RAG to Develop a Chatbot to Support Students in a Programming Course
sources.evidence_quote: chatbot was made available to students ... providing students with over a month to use the chatbot freely

assessment.summary: Complete Java programming exercises and assessments with optional course-specific chatbot support.
student_actions: Ask the chatbot to clarify concepts or explain code.
Check, adapt, and apply responses to assignments or exam preparation.

student_role.description: An anonymous GPT-3.5 RAG chatbot grounded in course videos, quizzes, exercises, and slides was freely available for over a month.

provenance.extraction_method: Full PDF read from pdftotext output.

reported_results: Students sent 1,059 messages; 30 survey respondents primarily used it for concepts and code explanations, and 36.7% reported directly using solutions without verification.

evidence_excerpts.quote: chatbot was made available to students ... providing students with over a month to use the chatbot freely
